Because of that, I’m washing my hands over and over—sometimes until they’re red and cracked. I’ll wipe down my workstation repeatedly before I can even start a design. It makes me late for meetings, and I avoid shaking hands with colleagues. I keep replaying it in my mind: “What if there’s some invisible toxin I brought home from the shop?” Even when I tell myself I’m being irrational, the fear doesn’t ease up unless I clean.

I don’t hear voices, I don’t see things, and I don’t feel like anyone is controlling my thoughts. It’s more like my own thoughts get stuck on this contamination idea and I can’t switch them off.
